products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital art application made available to the public through community governance. The foundation's website is located at krita.org, and its organizational structure reflects a community-driven model rather than a commercial one.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what it describes as Krita AI, an open-source digital art tool with local AI plugins that operate without cloud dependency. This approach means users run AI features on their own hardware rather than relying on external services, which the foundation presents as a distinguishing characteristic of the product.

The held facts on file confirm the foundation has an active profile page, is classified as an open-source foundation, and carries no recorded litigation or MCP server registrations. No SEC filings or patent records are associated with the organization, consistent with its non-profit and open-source standing.
